corpus: This Master Services Agreement extract (the "Agreement") governs the SaaS platform (the "Service") that Vendor provides to Customer. Vendor guarantees a Monthly Uptime Percentage of 99.9 percent for the Service, measured over each calendar month. If the Monthly Uptime Percentage for a calendar month is below 99.9 percent but at least 99.0 percent, Customer will receive a Service Credit equal to 10 percent of the fees paid for that month. If the Monthly Uptime Percentage for a calendar month is below 99.0 percent but at least 95.0 percent, Customer will receive a Service Credit equal to 25 percent of the fees paid for that month. If the Monthly Uptime Percentage for a calendar month is below 95.0 percent, Customer will receive a Service Credit equal to 50 percent of the fees paid for that month. Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon 60 days written notice to the other party. Either party may terminate this Agreement for cause upon 30 days written notice if the breaching party fails to cure a material breach within that period. Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, Vendor will retain Customer Data for 90 days to permit export, after which it will be permanently deleted. Vendor will retain audit logs for 12 months following creation, for compliance and security review purposes. Standard tier accounts, covering 1 to 49 licensed seats, are billed at a per-seat price of 45 dollars per month. Growth tier accounts, covering 50 to 199 licensed seats, are billed at a per-seat price of 36 dollars per month. Enterprise tier accounts, covering 200 or more licensed seats, are billed at a per-seat price of 28 dollars per month. Except for breaches of confidentiality or infringement of intellectual property, each party's total liability arising out of this Agreement is capped at an amount equal to 12 months of fees paid by Customer in the 12 months preceding the claim. For breaches of confidentiality, each party's total liability arising out of this Agreement is capped at an amount equal to 24 months of fees paid by Customer in the 12 months preceding the claim. Vendor will provide Customer with 45 days advance written notice of any material change to the Data Processing Addendum. Support tickets classified as Severity 1 will receive an initial response within 1 hour of submission. Support tickets classified as Severity 2 will receive an initial response within 4 business hours of submission.
